text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Tardive Dyskinesia

Risperidone, a high-potency first-generation antipsychotic in some classifications, is a known cause of movement disorders. Since your symptoms started two months after beginning risperidone and your levodopa levels are normal, we can rule out parkinsonism. Given your psychiatric history, Tardive Dyskinesia is the most likely diagnosis. Do you feel any involuntary movements in your face, tongue, or limbs?
